baseline.result: local unit/build/parity gates passed; browser gate initially blocked by a missing bundled Playwright executable
baseline.remediation: audits now use the configured browser or installed system Chrome deterministically

defects.summary: First-use chain stopped before explicit GO and verified insertion
defects.reproduction: Open a fresh side panel, capture a selection, queue an action, press GO, and insert a candidate.
defects.expected: One continuous, inert-until-GO path with a verified write receipt.

defects.summary: Website-first visitors reached a misleading Pearl command affordance
defects.reproduction: Open / without a trusted extension working set.
defects.expected: Show setup/recovery actions; reserve executable Pearl commands for a Scene.

defects.summary: Handoff route and cognitive query could claim an empty continuation
defects.expected: Report the missing working set and offer a retry without creating a Scene.

defects.summary: Continued work hid the expected Output Frame
defects.reproduction: Continue a trusted extension working set into a Scene and reload.
defects.expected: Open the Output Frame immediately and preserve one idempotent Scene.

defects.summary: Tour used stale paper/AI-void language and targeted a missing capture chip
defects.reproduction: Run the feature tour and advance to capture.
defects.expected: Use Scene/Output Frame/Pearl vocabulary and only reachable spotlight targets.

defects.summary: Disabled GO did not explain missing capture or action/Lens prerequisites
defects.reproduction: Open Review with no capture and no queued operation.
defects.expected: Show ordered prerequisites and keep GO inert.

defects.summary: Failures lacked actionable retry and safe insertion fallback
defects.reproduction: Deny page/mic permission, go offline, expire auth, or remove the insertion target.
defects.expected: Classify the blocker, preserve local state, and expose Retry or Copy guidance.

defects.summary: Primary controls were smaller than touch targets at narrow widths
defects.reproduction: Use a 360px panel, keyboard, touch, or 200% zoom.
defects.expected: Keep primary controls at least 40–44px while preserving 28–36px Pearl geometry.

defects.summary: Existing first-use and semantic tests were omitted from the main runner
defects.reproduction: Run npm test and inspect the explicit test list.
defects.expected: Run continuation, streaming generation, Lens grammar/grinding/rack, and output-specification tests.

defects.summary: First-use browser journeys were not one release-gated suite
defects.expected: Gate extension onboarding/capture/GO/insert, web continuation, brush, voice, adoption, and persistence.

defects.summary: First use explained capture and generation without creating a durable pearl
defects.reproduction: Select real page material and choose Make a pearl from this.
defects.expected: Persist one provenance-preserving semantic capsule, reopen its working context, expose the same canonical companion action, and carry it into a Scene.

externalChecks.reason: No live model credential is required or available to the deterministic release fixture.
Account adoption is exhaustively fixture-tested; a live Supabase account requires external credentials.
The unpacked production extension is browser-tested; Chrome Web Store signing and installation require store access.
